scope: Read-only integrated source review plus this evidence file; no external services or browser runtime exercised.

apiCallAstComparison.method: Parse HEAD and current sources with the installed @babel/parser; compare complete api.* and apiClient.* CallExpression subtrees as multisets, dropping only source locations, parser extra data and comments.

publicSourceIsolation.method: Recursively traverse static relative import/from and dynamic import string specifiers in JS/JSX/MJS/JSON, stripping Vite query suffixes.

unicodeAndFormContract.method: Compare HEAD/current matterValidation eligibility and matterPayload JSON for all seven categories and BMP Han, supplementary Han, emoji and combining-sequence strings at lengths 1/59/60/119/120/121.
unicodeAndFormContract.boundary: Existing UTF-16 .length/maxLength validation remains unchanged; no new code-point-counting contract is claimed.

focusedTests.command: node --test apps/web/tests/forms-i18n-render.test.mjs apps/web/tests/forms-i18n.test.mjs apps/web/tests/i18n-catalogs.test.mjs apps/web/tests/i18n-core.test.mjs apps/web/tests/public-i18n.test.mjs apps/web/tests/public-website.test.mjs apps/web/tests/sharing-i18n.test.mjs apps/web/tests/workspace-i18n.test.mjs

resolvedFindings: English missing-key plural fallback uses English PluralRules.
Automatic browser locale is not persisted or propagated as a manual preference; explicit choices are carried only to allowlisted App origins.
Legacy guide client fallback and server redirect preserve an explicitly supported locale enum without forwarding other untrusted query values.

manualReview.apiAndSecurityGuards: Reviewed changed IfStatement conditions. Changes concern localized confirmation descriptors, UI error states and display mapping; no removed request authorization gate identified.
manualReview.legalAndAuthentication: Accepted English legal document module and versioned contract remain byte-identical. Chinese account consent is reference text; unchecked/default consent gates and authentication API arguments remain unchanged.
manualReview.accessibility: Native language select has an associated label, lang-tagged options, visible focus styling and a storage-failure status description. English legal body is tagged by an external lang=en wrapper.
manualReview.preferences: Focused tests cover read/write storage failures, reload, invalid values, cross-tab changes, explicit vs implicit selection, handoff allowlists and preservation of unrelated query/hash/history state.

limits: Static source and Node/SSR checks are not browser interaction, keyboard, screenshot, responsive-layout, hosted-auth or deployment evidence.
API-call AST equality does not alone prove all control-flow security; changed conditions were also manually reviewed.
Catalog completeness is not a guarantee of perfect linguistic quality.

reproduction.focusedTests: Run focusedTests.command from the repository root.
reproduction.immutableDigests: For each immutableFiles entry compare git show HEAD:<file> | sha256sum with sha256sum <file>.
reproduction.sourceAlgorithms: The AST and graph algorithms are described in their respective method fields and use the locally installed parser; no network dependency is required.

sourceProvenance.kind: Exact-file sparse materialization through the authorized GitHub connector; not a remote Git clone.
sourceProvenance.localBaseline: baselineCommit identifies an unpublished local comparison checkpoint, not a published upstream commit.
sourceProvenance.normalization: The local checkpoint was amended after eight supplemental source/config files had transport-only surplus terminal LF removed and their Git blob SHAs verified. Functional localization changes were not folded into the checkpoint.
sourceProvenance.boundary: This review independently rechecks local HEAD/current digests. Upstream blob transport verification is distinct from these local digest checks.

finalDeltaReview.languageControl: Initial workspace loading/error gate and account-deletion status now include the existing accessible LanguageControl; request and deletion logic remain unchanged.
finalDeltaReview.documentTitle: Signed-in title is derived only from the existing activeNav enum and the active translator; effect performs no navigation or request.
finalDeltaReview.legacyGuideRedirect: worker/public-router.js forwards only the exact en / zh-CN enum alongside the existing allowlisted service. Destination remains hardcoded; arbitrary query values remain discarded; redirect remains no-store.
finalDeltaReview.routerTests: Positive en/zh-CN and negative zh-HK, script-like, query-injection, empty and undefined language cases pass, together with existing route/write rejection tests.
